description_excerpt: Job Description • Identify the potential clients and approach. • Find new clients and increase sales. • Maintain the good relationship with existing clients to improve sales revenue. • Plan to visit clients, prepare the marketing materials and sales kit • Work closely with customer service team to take care of clients. • Monthly update client's revenue, prepare sales and business reports • Support CS to solve complaints and collect outstanding debts • Prepare quotations, service offers and follow up • Prepare documents to attend tenders, bids…Perform other related tasks assigned by sales…
